description:
Das Spital Emmental sorgt mit Spezialistinnen und Spezialisten an den beiden Spitalstandorten Burgdorf und Langnau für die hochstehende medizinische Versorgung von 150 000 Einwohnerinnen und Einwohner – rund um die Uhr. Pflege mit Herz, Verstand und Flexibilität – willkommen im Spital Emmental. Was uns besonders macht? Als vielseitiges Peripheriespital mit Herz und Verstand leben wir ein vertrauensvolles Miteinander und ein Arbeitsklima, das von Offenheit, Respekt und Wertschätzung geprägt ist. Modern arbeiten heisst für uns: menschlich handeln, mit Gestaltungsfreiraum und einem offenen Ohr füreinander. Unsere Mitarbeitenden sind bei uns mittendrin statt nur dabei – fachlich wie persönlich. Familienfreundliche Bedingungen und eine gemeinsam gestaltete Dienstplanung gehören bei uns zum gelebten Alltag

Für unsere interdisziplinäre Notfallstation in Burgdorf und Langnau suchen wir per sofort oder nach Vereinbarung je ein:e

Deine Aufgaben – verantwortungsvoll und vielseitig

• Du betreust unsere Patientinnen und Patienten sowie ihre Angehörigen in akuten Situationen fachkompetent, einfühlsam und professionell
• Du übernimmst die Triage sowie die ganzheitliche Pflege auf der Notfallstation
• Gemeinsam mit dem ärztlichen Team gestaltest du die Erstversorgung unserer Akutpatientinnen und -patienten
• Du koordinierst die weitere Behandlung im interdisziplinären Team
• Du arbeitest im 24/7-Schichtbetrieb – Flexibilität ist für dich selbstverständlich

Dein Profil

• Du verfügst über ein Diplom in Pflege HF / FH (oder gleichwertiges ausländisches Diplom mit Anerkennung in der Schweiz)
• Du bringst Erfahrung in der Akutpflege mit (v.a. für Pflegende ohne NDS in Notfallpflege zwingend nötig)
• Du bist bereits anerkannte dipl. Expertin/ dipl. Experte Notfallpflege oder hast bei Interesse die Möglichkeit den Nachdiplomstudiengang in Notfallpflege zu absolvieren
• Du begegnest Menschen mit Respekt und Einfühlungsvermögen, denn das Wohl der Patientinnen und Patienten steht für dich an erster Stelle
• Du arbeitest gerne im Team, bist belastbar und verantwortungsbewusst

Unser Angebot
Planung Pflege Ferien GAV Kulinarisches Modern Menschlich Mittendrin Parkieren Anlässe Rabatte

Auskunft
Du bist flexibel, engagiert und bereit, dich immer wieder neuen Herausforderungen zu stellen? Dann suchen wir genau dich! Weitere Auskünfte erteilen dir gerne Lena Krebs / Leonie Scheidegger, Co-Abteilungsleiterinnen Notfallstation Burgdorf, Telefon 034 421 22 47 oder Rebekka Messerli, Abteilungsleiterin Notfallstation Langnau, Telefon 034 421 22 47.

Kontakt
Nathalie Ansorge-Rebora Human Resource Management

Adresse
Spital Emmental AG Human Resource Management 3400 Burgdorf www.spital-emmental.ch Wir sind Modern – Menschlich – Mittendrin und freuen uns auf alle! Con specialisti nelle due sedi ospedaliere di Burgdorf e Langnau, l'ospedale Emmental fornisce assistenza medica di alta qualità per 150.000 abitanti – intorno all'orologio. Cura con cuore, mente e flessibilità – benvenuto all'ospedale Emmental. Cosa ci rende speciali? Come un versatile ospedale periferico con cuore e mente, viviamo una solida convivenza e un ambiente di lavoro caratterizzato da apertura, rispetto e apprezzamento. Lavorare modernamente per noi significa: agire umanamente, con libertà di design e un orecchio aperto l'uno per l'altro. I nostri dipendenti sono in mezzo a noi invece che solo lì – sia professionalmente che personalmente. • Si prende il controllo del triage così come la cura olistica nel reparto di emergenza
• Insieme con il team medico, progettare la cura iniziale dei nostri pazienti acuti
• Coordinate l'ulteriore trattamento nel team interdisciplinare
• Lavorare a turni 24 ore su 24, 7 giorni su 7 – la flessibilità è una questione naturalmente per voi Il tuo profilo
• Ha un diploma in assistenza HF / FH (o diploma straniero equivalente con riconoscimento in Svizzera)
• Porti esperienza in cura acuta (specialmente per i caregiver senza NDS in assistenza di emergenza assolutamente necessario)
• Siete già riconosciuti dipl. Esperto/dipl. Expert Emergency Care o, se interessati, avere l'opportunità di completare il corso post-laurea in Emergency Care
• Si incontrano persone con rispetto ed empatia, perché il benessere dei pazienti viene prima per voi

descriptionByLocale.en:
With specialists at the two hospital locations in Burgdorf and Langnau, the Emmental Hospital provides high-quality medical care for 150,000 inhabitants – around the clock. Care with heart, mind and flexibility – welcome to the Emmental Hospital. What makes us special? As a versatile peripheral hospital with heart and mind, we live a trusting coexistence and a working environment that is characterized by openness, respect and appreciation. Working modernly for us means: acting humanely, with freedom of design and an open ear for each other. Our employees are in the middle of us instead of just there – both professionally and personally. Family-friendly conditions and jointly designed service planning are part of everyday life for us For our interdisciplinary emergency department in Burgdorf and Langnau we search immediately or by agreement:e Your tasks – responsible and versatile
• You support our patients and their relatives in acute situations competently, sensitively and professionally
• You take over the triage as well as the holistic care in the emergency department
• Together with the medical team, you will design the initial care of our acute patients
• You coordinate the further treatment in the interdisciplinary team
• You work in 24/7 shift operation – flexibility is a matter of course for you Your profile
• You have a diploma in care HF / FH (or equivalent foreign diploma with recognition in Switzerland)
• You bring experience in acute care (especially for caregivers without NDS in emergency care absolutely necessary)
• You are already recognized dipl. Expert/dipl. Expert Emergency Care or, if interested, have the opportunity to complete the post-graduate course in Emergency Care
• You meet people with respect and empathy, because the well-being of patients comes first for you
• You enjoy working in a team, are resilient and responsible Our offer Planning Care Holidays GAV Culinary Modern Human Center Parking Occasion Discounts

• You support our patients and their relatives in acute situations competently, sensitively and professionally
• You take over the triage as well as the holistic care in the emergency department
• Together with the medical team, you will design the initial care of our acute patients
• You coordinate the further treatment in the interdisciplinary team

• You have a diploma in care HF / FH (or equivalent foreign diploma with recognition in Switzerland)
• You bring experience in acute care (especially for caregivers without NDS in emergency care absolutely necessary)

• You meet people with respect and empathy, because the well-being of patients comes first for you
• You enjoy working in a team, are resilient and responsible Our Planning Care offer: With careful assignment planning we try to meet individual wishes as much as possible. Holidays: Special Holiday Plans? If the annual 25 to 32 holiday days are not enough, the possibility of an unpaid holiday can be checked with us. Our employees also get an extra day off for their birthday! GAV: Our terms and conditions of employment are based on the general employment contract (GAV) for the staff of Bern hospitals and clinics. Culinary: Our cuisines in Burgdorf and Langnau work largely with seasonal, healthy and local products. Employees benefit from a discount and can be pampered by a versatile buffet selection. Microwaves for self-bred goods are also available. Parking: Employees can use different parking spaces depending on the location. Access and billing are done via Parkingpay card. Occasions: To promote our corporate culture, we give our employees a day off. Colleagues from different departments can participate in a ski, bike, pop, hiking, fun, Christmas market or culture day. Discounts: On the intranet, our employees can find information/links on numerous attractive offers and benefit from reduced prices, e.g. at indoor pools, cinemas, cars or in regional pharmacies. Are you looking for a "Kafi"? Before you send your application, you can get to know us very easily at a comfortable "Kafi meeting". We look forward to answering questions and giving you an insight into our team – without obligation. Are you flexible, committed and ready to face new challenges again and again? Then we are looking for you!
